A House Like an Orange

085
summary_zh: 小鼹鼠感谢小黑熊送给他一阵躲在树上的夏雨，右侧页面显示章节标题“像橘子一样的房子”。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小熊在森林里造了一幢房子。
那是一幢美丽的小房子。
小熊说了，等他的新房造好以后，他要请所有的好朋友来做客，还要
用最好的食物来招待他们。
朋友们呢，也都盼着小熊的房子
快点造好。
小豪猪看见小熊装好了最后一
块窗玻璃，他说：“我要买一桶油漆送
给小熊，帮他漆漆新房子。”
page_text_en:
The little bear built a house in the forest.
It was a beautiful little house.
The bear said, after his new house was finished, he would invite all his good friends to visit, and he would use the best food to entertain them.
What about the friends? They were all looking forward to the bear's house
being finished soon.
The little boar saw the bear had installed the last
windowpane, and he said, "I'll buy a bucket of paint to give to the bear, to help him paint his new house."
summary_zh: 小熊在森林里建造了一幢美丽的新房子，朋友们都期待着房子完工。小豪猪看到小熊装好最后一块窗玻璃，决定买油漆帮忙漆新房子。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小熊看见朋友们的礼物，又高兴又发愁。他感谢朋友们的关心和帮助，但他不想把他的房子变成一艘大轮船、一个大苹果或者一朵向日葵。

小熊平时非常爱吃橘子，他想把自己的房子漆成橘红色，就像一个大橘子；他还想把周围的木栅栏，漆成绿色的，就像一丛绿叶子，这让人喜爱。

听了小熊的话，三个朋友都傻眼了。
page_text_en:
The little bear saw his friends' gifts and felt both happy and worried. He thanked them for their care and help, but he didn't want to turn his house into a big ship, a big apple, or a sunflower.

The little bear loved eating oranges. He wanted to paint his house orange, like a big orange; he also wanted to paint the surrounding wooden fence green, like a bush of green leaves, which would be lovely.

After hearing the little bear's words, the three friends were stunned.
summary_zh: 小熊感谢朋友们送的礼物，但不想把房子漆成轮船、苹果或向日葵的样子。他想把房子漆成橘红色，栅栏漆成绿色，像橘子和绿叶。朋友们听了他的想法后都愣住了。

page_text_ocr_zh:
这时候，小熊的另一个好朋友小浣熊经过这里，他说：“不难，不难，这是很容易解决的！”
小浣熊提起桶，倒半桶黄漆在红漆里，搅拌了一下，说：“瞧，这不成了橘红色的油漆了吗？”
小熊、小刺猬、小兔子提着漆桶，去油漆小房子了。
小浣熊再把剩下的半桶黄漆倒进蓝漆桶里，搅拌了一下，说：“这不就成了绿颜色的油漆了吗？”
小浣熊和小豪猪提着这桶漆，去油漆房子周围的木栅栏了。
page_text_en:
At this moment, Little Bear's other good friend, Little Raccoon, passed by. He said, "Not difficult, not difficult, this is very easy to solve!"
Little Raccoon picked up the bucket, poured half a bucket of yellow paint into the red paint, stirred it, and said, "Look, isn't this orange paint now?"
Little Bear, Little Hedgehog, and Little Rabbit carried the paint buckets to paint the little house.
Little Raccoon then poured the remaining half bucket of yellow paint into the blue paint bucket, stirred it, and said, "Isn't this green paint now?"
Little Raccoon and Little Porcupine carried this bucket of paint to paint the wooden fence around the house.
summary_zh: 小浣熊为小熊的房子调配橘红色和绿色油漆，并和朋友们一起开始油漆房子和栅栏。

page_text_ocr_zh:
没过多久，一幢像橘子一样美丽的小房子出现了。“橘子”的周围，还有一丛绿色的“叶子”呢，那是漂亮的绿栅栏。
小熊请朋友们进屋做客，他用最好的食物招待大伙儿。
那是什么呢？你猜到了吧——
那是一个个带着几片绿叶的，又大又甜的橘子……
page_text_en:
Not long after, a beautiful little house, just like an orange, appeared. Around the "orange," there was a green "leaf"—a lovely green fence.
Bear invited his friends inside for a visit and treated everyone with the best food.
What could it be? You've guessed it—
It was one big, sweet orange after another, each with a few green leaves...
summary_zh: 小熊的新房子像橘子一样建成，他用美味的橘子招待朋友们，画面中展示了橘子的插图。
